alternatives_evaluated.name: custom TM, central meridian 67.05E, k0 0.9996
alternatives_evaluated.reason_for_test: zone 42N central meridian 69E lies about 170-200 km east of Karachi, so Karachi sits far from the meridian
alternatives_evaluated.verdict: lower distortion but breaks the locked EPSG:32642 decision and OSM/UTM tooling familiarity; the measured 32642 error is already far below gameplay tolerance, so EPSG:32642 is retained

axis_convention.godot_z: N0 - northing_m, increases southward, so north is negative Z

engine.note: no Godot binary on PATH or under C:/D:/E: at depth 3; project.godot declares features 4.7 + GL Compatibility but that string is not evidence of an installed engine. The Godot-side implementation of this contract is therefore a specification, unverified until the editor is installed and a headless test is run.

floating_origin.rule: global projected coordinates stay 64-bit and are kept separate from local Godot Vector3; rebasing must move physics bodies, navigation, cameras, particles and audio together or not at all

origin.change_policy: changing E0/N0 after chunks exist requires a versioned migration
origin.rule: E0 = floor(min_easting/512)*512 and N0 = ceil(max_northing/512)*512 over the L1 administrative extent only, tile-aligned so every chunk index inside the division is non-negative. L2 and L3 reach the clip box because that is how they were cut, which is a processing artifact and deliberately not used to size the world
origin.vertical_datum: UNSET - no licensed elevation source; game Y uses a documented ground-height fallback of 0 m

transformations.chunk_to_local: local_x=easting-(E0+chunk_x*512); local_z=N0-northing-(chunk_z*512) then offset by chunk origin

working_crs_definition: WGS 84 / UTM zone 42N, central meridian 69E, k0 0.9996, false E 500000, false N 0
